LanguageData.DigitalStoragePatch_ReceivingShelf.label: Digital Receiving Shelf
LanguageData.DigitalStoragePatch_ReceivingShelf.descr:
The receiving end of digital storage. Items placed on this shelf are automatically taken into the digital storage core — they are never taken back out.
It uses the vanilla storage system, so colonists and any hauling mod will drop items onto it normally; you just throw things on the shelf. The accepted item types match the digital core (it follows the core's filter, and re-syncs when you change that filter). Anything the core cannot accept — filter mismatch or the core is full — simply stays on the shelf.
By default it picks a usable digital core on this map automatically. You can also use "Bind core" to name a specific one (including a core on another map that a projection core has authorized).
